title: silene involucrata subsp. furcata
intro: Silene involucrata subsp. furcata, commonly known as the Alpine Catchfly, is a plant species within the carnation family. The Alpine Catchfly has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and promote overall well-being. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and wound-healing properties, making it a valuable resource for wound care and tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of the Alpine Catchfly include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
